hooks.command: if [ -f .claude/hooks/tdd_guard.py ]; then python3 .claude/hooks/tdd_guard.py; elif [ -n "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" ] && [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/tdd_guard.py" ]; then python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/tdd_guard.py"; else exit 0; fi
FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty') && if echo "$FILE" | grep -q '\.py$'; then python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('$FILE').read())" 2>&1 || echo "SYNTAX ERROR in $FILE"; fi
